    created_at: datetime.datetime = field(default_factory=datetime.datetime.now)
    is_active: bool = True
    
    def to_dict(self) -> Dict:
        """Convert user to dictionary for storage."""
        return {
            "id": self.id,
            "username": self.username,
            "email": self.email,
            "password_hash": self.password_hash,
            "role": self.role.value,
            "created_at": self.created_at.isoformat(),
            "is_active": self.is_active
        }
    
    @staticmethod
    def from_dict(data: Dict) -> 'User':
        """Create user from dictionary."""
        user = User(
            id=data.get("id", str(uuid.uuid4())),
            username=data["username"],
            email=data["email"],
            password_hash=data["password_hash"],
            role=UserRole(data["role"]),
            is_active=data.get("is_active", True)
        )
        if "created_at" in data:
            user.created_at = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(data["created_at"])
        return user

@dataclass
class ArticleVersion:
    """Version control for article content."""
    version_id: int = 1
    content: str = ""
    created_at: datetime.datetime = field(default_factory=datetime.datetime.now)
    created_by: str = ""  # User ID
    changes_summary: str = ""
    
    def to_dict(self) -> Dict:
        """Convert version to dictionary."""
        return {
            "version_id": self.version_id,
            "content": self.content,
            "created_at": self.created_at.isoformat(),
            "created_by": self.created_by,
            "changes_summary": self.changes_summary
        }
    
    @staticmethod
    def from_dict(data: Dict) -> 'ArticleVersion':
        """Create version from dictionary."""
        version = ArticleVersion(
            version_id=data["version_id"],
            content=data["content"],
            created_by=data["created_by"],
            changes_summary=data.get("changes_summary", "")
        )
        if "created_at" in data:
            version.created_at = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(data["created_at"])
        return version

@dataclass
class Comment:
    """Comment model for article discussions."""
    id: str = field(default_factory=lambda: str(uuid.uuid4()))
    article_id: str = ""
    user_id: str = ""
    content: str = ""
    created_at: datetime.datetime = field(default_factory=datetime.datetime.now)
    parent_comment_id: Optional[str] = None  # For threaded comments
    
    def to_dict(self) -> Dict:
        """Convert comment to dictionary."""
        return {
            "id": self.id,
            "article_id": self.article_id,
            "user_id": self.user_id,
            "content": self.content,
            "created_at": self.created_at.isoformat(),
            "parent_comment_id": self.parent_comment_id
        }
    
    @staticmethod
    def from_dict(data: Dict) -> 'Comment':
        """Create comment from dictionary."""
        comment = Comment(
            id=data.get("id", str(uuid.uuid4())),
            article_id=data["article_id"],
            user_id=data["user_id"],
            content=data["content"],
            parent_comment_id=data.get("parent_comment_id")
        )
        if "created_at" in data:
            comment.created_at = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(data["created_at"])
        return comment

@dataclass
class Article:
    """Main article model with collaboration features."""
    id: str = field(default_factory=lambda: str(uuid.uuid4()))
    title: str = ""
    summary: str = ""
    current_version: ArticleVersion = field(default_factory=ArticleVersion)
    versions: List[ArticleVersion] = field(default_factory=list)
    status: ArticleStatus = ArticleStatus.DRAFT
    verification_status: VerificationStatus = VerificationStatus.PENDING
    created_by: str = ""  # User ID
    created_at: datetime.datetime = field(default_factory=datetime.datetime.now)
    updated_at: datetime.datetime = field(default_factory=datetime.datetime.now)
    assigned_editor: Optional[str] = None  # User ID
    tags: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    collaborators: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)  # User IDs
    
    def to_dict(self) -> Dict:
        """Convert article to dictionary for storage."""
        return {
            "id": self.id,
            "title": self.title,
            "summary": self.summary,
            "current_version": self.current_version.to_dict(),
            "versions": [v.to_dict() for v in self.versions],
            "status": self.status.value,
            "verification_status": self.verification_status.value,
            "created_by": self.created_by,
            "created_at": self.created_at.isoformat(),
            "updated_at": self.updated_at.isoformat(),
            "assigned_editor": self.assigned_editor,
            "tags": self.tags,
            "collaborators": self.collaborators
        }
    
    @staticmethod
    def from_dict(data: Dict) -> 'Article':
        """Create article from dictionary."""
        article = Article(
            id=data.get("id", str(uuid.uuid4())),
            title=data["title"],
            summary=data.get("summary", ""),
            status=ArticleStatus(data["status"]),
            verification_status=VerificationStatus(data.get("verification_status", "pending")),
            created_by=data["created_by"],
            assigned_editor=data.get("assigned_editor"),
            tags=data.get("tags", []),
            collaborators=data.get("collaborators", [])
        )
        
        # Parse dates
        if "created_at" in data:
            article.created_at = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(data["created_at"])
        if "updated_at" in data:
            article.updated_at = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(data["updated_at"])
        
        # Parse versions
        article.current_version = ArticleVersion.from_dict(data["current_version"])
        article.versions = [ArticleVersion.from_dict(v) for v in data.get("versions", [])]
        
        return article
    
    def create_new_version(self, content: str, user_id: str, changes_summary: str = "") -> None:
        """Create a new version of the article."""
        new_version = ArticleVersion(
            version_id=self.current_version.version_id + 1,
            content=content,
            created_by=user_id,
            changes_summary=changes_summary
        )
        self.versions.append(self.current_version)
        self.current_version = new_version
        self.updated_at = datetime.datetime.now()

class AuditLog:
    """Audit log for tracking user activities."""
    id: str = field(default_factory=lambda: str(uuid.uuid4()))
    user_id: str = ""
    action: str = ""
    resource_type: str = ""
    resource_id: str = ""
    details: Dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    timestamp: datetime.datetime = field(default_factory=datetime.datetime.now)
    
    def to_dict(self) -> Dict:

        return {
            "id": self.id,
            "user_id": self.user_id,
            "action": self.action,
            "resource_type": self.resource_type,
            "resource_id": self.resource_id,
            "details": self.details,
            "timestamp": self.timestamp.isoformat()
        }

@dataclass
class Notification:
    """Notification model for user alerts."""
    id: str = field(default_factory=lambda: str(uuid.uuid4()))
    user_id: str = ""
    title: str = ""
    message: str = ""
    notification_type: str = ""  # comment, change, verification, etc.
    related_resource_id: str = ""

        return {
            "id": self.id,
            "user_id": self.user_id,
            "title": self.title,
            "message": self.message,
            "notification_type": self.notification_type,
            "related_resource_id": self.related_resource_id,
            "is_read": self.is_read,
            "created_at": self.created_at.isoformat()
        }

# ============================
# DATABASE LAYER
# ============================

class Database:
    """In-memory database for demonstration purposes.
    In production, this would be replaced with a proper database like PostgreSQL."""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.users: Dict[str, User] = {}
        self.articles: Dict[str, Article] = {}
        self.comments: Dict[str, Comment] = {}
        self.audit_logs: List[AuditLog] = []
        self.notifications: Dict[str, List[Notification]] = {}  # user_id -> list of notifications
        
        # Create admin user for demo
        self._create_default_admin()
    
    def _create_default_admin(self):
        """Create a default admin user for demonstration."""
        admin = User(
            username="admin",
            email="admin@newscollab.com",
            password_hash=self._hash_password("admin123"),
            role=UserRole.ADMIN
        )
        self.users[admin.id] = admin
    
    def _hash_password(self, password: str) -> str:
        """Hash a password for storage."""
        salt = os.urandom(32)
        key = hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac('sha256', password.encode('utf-8'), salt, 100000)
        return salt.hex() + key.hex()
    
    def verify_password(self, stored_hash: str, provided_password: str) -> bool:
        """Verify a password against its hash."""
        salt = bytes.fromhex(stored_hash[:64])
        stored_key = stored_hash[64:]
        key = hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac('sha256', provided_password.encode('utf-8'), salt, 100000)
        return key.hex() == stored_key
    
    # User operations
    def add_user(self, user: User) -> str:
        """Add a new user to the database."""
        self.users[user.id] = user
        return user.id
    
    def get_user(self, user_id: str) -> Optional[User]:
        """Get a user by ID."""
        return self.users.get(user_id)
    
    def get_user_by_username(self, username: str) -> Optional[User]:
        """Get a user by username."""
        for user in self.users.values():
            if user.username == username:
                return user
        return None
    
    def get_user_by_email(self, email: str) -> Optional[User]:
        """Get a user by email."""
        for user in self.users.values():
            if user.email == email:
                return user
        return None
    
    # Article operations
    def add_article(self, article: Article) -> str:
        """Add a new article to the database."""
        self.articles[article.id] = article
        return article.id
    
    def get_article(self, article_id: str) -> Optional[Article]:
        """Get an article by ID."""
        return self.articles.get(article_id)
    
    def update_article(self, article: Article) -> bool:
        """Update an existing article."""
        if article.id in self.articles:
            self.articles[article.id] = article
            return True
        return False
    
    def get_articles_by_user(self, user_id: str) -> List[Article]:
        """Get all articles created by or assigned to a user."""
        user_articles = []
        for article in self.articles.values():
            if (article.created_by == user_id or 
                article.assigned_editor == user_id or
                user_id in article.collaborators):
                user_articles.append(article)
        return user_articles
    
    def get_all_articles(self) -> List[Article]:
        """Get all articles."""
        return list(self.articles.values())
    
    # Comment operations
    def add_comment(self, comment: Comment) -> str:
        """Add a new comment."""
        self.comments[comment.id] = comment
        return comment.id
    
    def get_comments_for_article(self, article_id: str) -> List[Comment]:
        """Get all comments for an article."""
        return [c for c in self.comments.values() if c.article_id == article_id]
    
    # Audit log operations
    def add_audit_log(self, log: AuditLog) -> None:
        """Add an audit log entry."""
        self.audit_logs.append(log)
    
    def get_audit_logs(self, user_id: Optional[str] = None) -> List[AuditLog]:
        """Get audit logs, optionally filtered by user."""
        if user_id:
            return [log for log in self.audit_logs if log.user_id == user_id]
        return self.audit_logs
    
    # Notification operations
    def add_notification(self, notification: Notification) -> None:
        """Add a notification."""
        if notification.user_id not in self.notifications:
            self.notifications[notification.user_id] = []
        self.notifications[notification.user_id].append(notification)
    
    def get_user_notifications(self, user_id: str, unread_only: bool = False) -> List[Notification]:
        """Get notifications for a user."""
        user_notifications = self.notifications.get(user_id, [])
        if unread_only:
            return [n for n in user_notifications if not n.is_read]
        return user_notifications
    
    def mark_notification_as_read(self, notification_id: str, user_id: str) -> bool:

"""

"""
import re
from typing import Dict, List, Tuple
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.naive_bayes import MultinomialNB
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
import joblib
import requests
from urllib.parse import urlparse

class VerificationModule:
    """Machine learning module for verifying article credibility"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        # Initialize ML pipeline
        self.vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(max_features=5000, stop_words='english')
        self.classifier = MultinomialNB()
        self.pipeline = Pipeline([
            ('vectorizer', self.vectorizer),
            ('classifier', self.classifier)
        ])
        
        # Known credible sources database (in production, this would be external)
        self.credible_sources = {
            'reuters.com', 'apnews.com', 'bbc.com', 'nytimes.com',
            'theguardian.com', 'washingtonpost.com', 'bloomberg.com'
        }
        
        # Load or train model
        try:
            self.pipeline = joblib.load('verification_model.pkl')
            self.is_trained = True
        except:
            self.is_trained = False
            # Initialize with some training data
            self._initialize_model()
    
    def _initialize_model(self):
        """Initialize with basic training data"""
        # In production, this would use a large dataset of verified/unverified articles
        texts = [
            "Official statement from government press release",
            "Confirmed by multiple independent sources",
            "Breaking news from reliable journalist",
            "Unverified claim from anonymous source",
            "Rumors circulating on social media",
            "Fact-checked and confirmed information"
        ]
        labels = [1, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1]  # 1 = credible, 0 = not credible
        
        self.pipeline.fit(texts, labels)
        self.is_trained = True
        joblib.dump(self.pipeline, 'verification_model.pkl')
    
    def verify_article(self, article_content: str, sources: List[Dict]) -> Dict:
        """
        Verify an article's credibility
        
        Args:
            article_content: The article text
            sources: List of sources with metadata
            
        Returns:
            Dictionary with verification results
        """
        results = {
            'overall_score': 0.0,
            'is_verified': False,
            'source_analysis': [],
            'content_analysis': {},
            'warnings': []
        }
        
        # Analyze sources
        source_scores = []
        for source in sources:
            source_result = self._analyze_source(source)
            results['source_analysis'].append(source_result)
            source_scores.append(source_result.get('reliability_score', 0.0))
            
            if source_result.get('warning'):
                results['warnings'].append(f"Source warning: {source_result['warning']}")
        
        # Analyze content
        content_result = self._analyze_content(article_content)
        results['content_analysis'] = content_result
        
        # Calculate overall score
        if source_scores:
            avg_source_score = np.mean(source_scores)
            content_score = content_result.get('credibility_score', 0.5)
            
            # Weighted average: 60% sources, 40% content
            results['overall_score'] = (avg_source_score * 0.6) + (content_score * 0.4)
        else:
            results['overall_score'] = content_result.get('credibility_score', 0.5)
        
        # Determine verification status
        results['is_verified'] = results['overall_score'] >= 0.7
        
        return results
    
    def _analyze_source(self, source: Dict) -> Dict:
        """Analyze a single source's credibility"""
        result = {
            'url': source.get('url', ''),
            'type': source.get('type', 'unknown'),
            'reliability_score': 0.5,
            'is_known_credible': False,
            'warning': None
        }
        
        url = source.get('url', '')
        if url:
            try:
                domain = urlparse(url).netloc.lower()
                if any(credible in domain for credible in self.credible_sources):
                    result['reliability_score'] = 0.9
                    result['is_known_credible'] = True
                elif domain.endswith('.gov') or domain.endswith('.edu'):
                    result['reliability_score'] = 0.8
                elif 'twitter.com' in domain or 'facebook.com' in domain:
                    result['reliability_score'] = 0.3
                    result['warning'] = 'Social media source - requires additional verification'
            except:
                pass
        
        # Check source metadata
        if source.get('official', False):
            result['reliability_score'] = max(result['reliability_score'], 0.7)
        
        if source.get('anonymous', False):
            result['reliability_score'] *= 0.5
            result['warning'] = 'Anonymous source - reduced credibility'
        
        return result
    
    def _analyze_content(self, content: str) -> Dict:
        """Analyze article content for credibility indicators"""
        result = {
            'credibility_score': 0.5,
            'has_quotes': False,
            'has_data': False,
            'sentiment_score': 0.0,
            'readability_score': 0.0
        }
        
        # Check for quotes
        quote_pattern = r'["\'][^"\']+["\']'
        if re.search(quote_pattern, content):
            result['has_quotes'] = True
            result['credibility_score'] += 0.1
        
        # Check for data/statistics
        num_pattern = r'\b\d+\.?\d*\b'
        numbers = re.findall(num_pattern, content)
        if len(numbers) >= 3:
            result['has_data'] = True
            result['credibility_score'] += 0.15
        
        # Use ML model for content analysis
        if self.is_trained and len(content) > 50:
            try:
                prob = self.pipeline.predict_proba([content])[0]
                if len(prob) > 1:
                    result['credibility_score'] = prob[1]  # Probability of being credible
            except:
                pass
        
        # Cap score between 0 and 1
        result['credibility_score'] = max(0.0, min(1.0, result['credibility_score']))
        
        return result
    
    def retrain_model(self, texts: List[str], labels: List[int]):
        """Retrain the ML model with new data"""
        self.pipeline.fit(texts, labels)
        self.is_trained = True
        joblib.dump(self.pipeline, 'verification_model.pkl')

        ])

        self.credible_sources = {
            'reuters.com', 'apnews.com', 'bbc.com', 'nytimes.com',
            'theguardian.com', 'washingtonpost.com', 'bloomberg.com'
        }
        
        # Load or train model
        try:
            self.pipeline = joblib.load('verification_model.pkl')
            self.is_trained = True
        except:
            self.is_trained = False
            # Initialize with some training data
            self._initialize_model()
    
    def _initialize_model(self):
        """Initialize with basic training data"""
        # In production, this would use a large dataset of verified/unverified articles
        texts = [
            "Official statement from government press release",
            "Confirmed by multiple independent sources",
            "Breaking news from reliable journalist",
            "Unverified claim from anonymous source",
            "Rumors circulating on social media",
            "Fact-checked and confirmed information"
        ]
        labels = [1, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1]  # 1 = credible, 0 = not credible
        
        self.pipeline.fit(texts, labels)
        self.is_trained = True
        joblib.dump(self.pipeline, 'verification_model.pkl')
    
    def verify_article(self, article_content: str, sources: List[Dict]) -> Dict:
        """
        Verify an article's credibility
        
        Args:
            article_content: The article text
            sources: List of sources with metadata
            
        Returns:
            Dictionary with verification results
        """
        results = {
            'overall_score': 0.0,
            'is_verified': False,
            'source_analysis': [],
            'content_analysis': {},
            'warnings': []
        }
        
        # Analyze sources
        source_scores = []
        for source in sources:
            source_result = self._analyze_source(source)
            results['source_analysis'].append(source_result)
            source_scores.append(source_result.get('reliability_score', 0.0))
            
            if source_result.get('warning'):
                results['warnings'].append(f"Source warning: {source_result['warning']}")
        
        # Analyze content
        content_result = self._analyze_content(article_content)
        results['content_analysis'] = content_result
        
        # Calculate overall score
        if source_scores:
            avg_source_score = np.mean(source_scores)
            content_score = content_result.get('credibility_score', 0.5)
            
            # Weighted average: 60% sources, 40% content
            results['overall_score'] = (avg_source_score * 0.6) + (content_score * 0.4)
        else:
            results['overall_score'] = content_result.get('credibility_score', 0.5)
        
        # Determine verification status
        results['is_verified'] = results['overall_score'] >= 0.7
        
        return results
    
    def _analyze_source(self, source: Dict) -> Dict:
        """Analyze a single source's credibility"""
        result = {
            'url': source.get('url', ''),
            'type': source.get('type', 'unknown'),
            'reliability_score': 0.5,
            'is_known_credible': False,
            'warning': None
        }
        
        url = source.get('url', '')
        if url:
            try:
                domain = urlparse(url).netloc.lower()
                if any(credible in domain for credible in self.credible_sources):
                    result['reliability_score'] = 0.9
                    result['is_known_credible'] = True
                elif domain.endswith('.gov') or domain.endswith('.edu'):
                    result['reliability_score'] = 0.8
                elif 'twitter.com' in domain or 'facebook.com' in domain:
                    result['reliability_score'] = 0.3
                    result['warning'] = 'Social media source - requires additional verification'
            except:
                pass
        
        # Check source metadata
        if source.get('official', False):
            result['reliability_score'] = max(result['reliability_score'], 0.7)
        
        if source.get('anonymous', False):
            result['reliability_score'] *= 0.5
            result['warning'] = 'Anonymous source - reduced credibility'
        
        return result
    
    def _analyze_content(self, content: str) -> Dict:
        """Analyze article content for credibility indicators"""
        result = {
            'credibility_score': 0.5,
            'has_quotes': False,
            'has_data': False,
            'sentiment_score': 0.0,
            'readability_score': 0.0
        }
        
        # Check for quotes
        quote_pattern = r'["\'][^"\']+["\']'
        if re.search(quote_pattern, content):
            result['has_quotes'] = True
            result['credibility_score'] += 0.1
        
        # Check for data/statistics
        num_pattern = r'\b\d+\.?\d*\b'
        numbers = re.findall(num_pattern, content)
        if len(numbers) >= 3:
            result['has_data'] = True
            result['credibility_score'] += 0.15
        
        # Use ML model for content analysis
        if self.is_trained and len(content) > 50:
            try:
                prob = self.pipeline.predict_proba([content])[0]
                if len(prob) > 1:
                    result['credibility_score'] = prob[1]  # Probability of being credible
            except:
                pass
        
        # Cap score between 0 and 1
        result['credibility_score'] = max(0.0, min(1.0, result['credibility_score']))
        
        return result
    
    def retrain_model(self, texts: List[str], labels: List[int]):
        """Retrain the ML model with new data"""
        self.pipeline.fit(texts, labels)
        self.is_trained = True
        joblib.dump(self.pipeline, 'verification_model.pkl')

"""
Database models for users, articles, comments, and collaboration data
"""
from datetime import datetime
from flask_sqlalchemy import SQLAlchemy
from flask_login import UserMixin
from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql import JSONB
import json

db = SQLAlchemy()

class User(UserMixin, db.Model):
    """User model for journalists and editors"""
    __tablename__ = 'users'
    
    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    username = db.Column(db.String(80), unique=True, nullable=False)
    email = db.Column(db.String(120), unique=True, nullable=False)
    password_hash = db.Column(db.String(256), nullable=False)
    role = db.Column(db.Enum('journalist', 'editor', 'admin', name='user_roles'), 
                     nullable=False, default='journalist')
    created_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)
    is_active = db.Column(db.Boolean, default=True)
    
    # Relationships
    articles = db.relationship('Article', backref='author', lazy=True)
    comments = db.relationship('Comment', backref='user', lazy=True)
    edits = db.relationship('ArticleEdit', backref='editor', lazy=True)
    
    def to_dict(self):
        """Convert user to dictionary for API responses"""
        return {
            'id': self.id,
            'username': self.username,
            'email': self.email,
            'role': self.role,
            'created_at': self.created_at.isoformat()
        }


class Article(db.Model):
    """News article model with versioning support"""
    __tablename__ = 'articles'
    
    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    title = db.Column(db.String(200), nullable=False)
    content = db.Column(db.Text, nullable=False)
    summary = db.Column(db.Text)
    status = db.Column(db.Enum('draft', 'under_review', 'published', 'archived', 
                              name='article_status'), default='draft')
    category = db.Column(db.String(50))
    tags = db.Column(JSONB)  # JSON array of tags
    sources = db.Column(JSONB)  # JSON array of sources with metadata
    verification_score = db.Column(db.Float, default=0.0)
    is_verified = db.Column(db.Boolean, default=False)
    created_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)
    updated_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)
    published_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, nullable=True)
    
    # Foreign keys
    author_id = db.Column(db.Integer, db.ForeignKey('users.id'), nullable=False)
    current_version = db.Column(db.Integer, default=1)
    
    # Relationships
    versions = db.relationship('ArticleVersion', backref='article', lazy=True)
    comments = db.relationship('Comment', backref='article', lazy=True, cascade='all, delete-orphan')
    edits = db.relationship('ArticleEdit', backref='article', lazy=True)
    notifications = db.relationship('Notification', backref='article', lazy=True)
    
    def to_dict(self, include_content=True):
        """Convert article to dictionary"""
        data = {
            'id': self.id,
            'title': self.title,
            'summary': self.summary,
            'status': self.status,
            'category': self.category,
            'tags': self.tags or [],
            'sources': self.sources or [],
            'verification_score': self.verification_score,
            'is_verified': self.is_verified,
            'created_at': self.created_at.isoformat(),
            'updated_at': self.updated_at.isoformat(),
            'published_at': self.published_at.isoformat() if self.published_at else None,
            'author': self.author.to_dict() if self.author else None,
            'current_version': self.current_version,
            'comment_count': len(self.comments)
        }
        if include_content:
            data['content'] = self.content
        return data


class ArticleVersion(db.Model):

"""
Machine learning module for source and content verification
"""
import re
from typing import Dict, List, Tuple
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.naive_bayes import MultinomialNB
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
import joblib
import requests
from urllib.parse import urlparse

class VerificationModule:
    """Machine learning module for verifying article credibility"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        # Initialize ML pipeline
        self.vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(max_features=5000, stop_words='english')
        self.classifier = MultinomialNB()
        self.pipeline = Pipeline([
            ('vectorizer', self.vectorizer),
            ('classifier', self.classifier)
        ])
        
        # Known credible sources database (in production, this would be external)
        self.credible_sources = {
            'reuters.com', 'apnews.com', 'bbc.com', 'nytimes.com',
            'theguardian.com', 'washingtonpost.com', 'bloomberg.com'
        }
        
        # Load or train model
        try:
            self.pipeline = joblib.load('verification_model.pkl')
            self.is_trained = True
        except:
            self.is_trained = False
            # Initialize with some training data
            self._initialize_model()
    
    def _initialize_model(self):
        """Initialize with basic training data"""
        # In production, this would use a large dataset of verified/unverified articles
        texts = [
            "Official statement from government press release",
            "Confirmed by multiple independent sources",
            "Breaking news from reliable journalist",
            "Unverified claim from anonymous source",
            "Rumors circulating on social media",
            "Fact-checked and confirmed information"
        ]
        # Ensure tldextract is available for domain parsing
        import tldextract
        
        # In production, this would use a large dataset of verified/unverified articles
        labels = [1, 1, 1, 0, 0, 1]  # 1 = credible, 0 = not credible
        
        self.pipeline.fit(texts, labels)
        self.is_trained = True
        joblib.dump(self.pipeline, 'verification_model.pkl')
    
    def verify_article(self, article_content: str, sources: List[Dict]) -> Dict:
        """
        Verify an article's credibility
        
        Args:
            article_content: The article text
            sources: List of sources with metadata
            
        Returns:
            Dictionary with verification results
        """
        results = {
            'overall_score': 0.0,
            'is_verified': False,
            'source_analysis': [],
            'content_analysis': {},
            'warnings': []
        }
        
        # Analyze sources
        source_scores = []
        for source in sources:
            source_result = self._analyze_source(source)
            results['source_analysis'].append(source_result)
            source_scores.append(source_result.get('reliability_score', 0.0))
            
            if source_result.get('warning'):
                results['warnings'].append(f"Source warning: {source_result['warning']}")
        
        # Analyze content
        content_result = self._analyze_content(article_content)
        results['content_analysis'] = content_result
        
        # Calculate overall score
        if source_scores:
            avg_source_score = np.mean(source_scores)
            content_score = content_result.get('credibility_score', 0.5)
            
            # Weighted average: 60% sources, 40% content
            results['overall_score'] = (avg_source_score * 0.6) + (content_score * 0.4)
        else:
            results['overall_score'] = content_result.get('credibility_score', 0.5)
        
        # Determine verification status
        results['is_verified'] = results['overall_score'] >= 0.7
        
        return results
    
    def _analyze_source(self, source: Dict) -> Dict:
        """Analyze a single source's credibility"""
        result = {
            'url': source.get('url', ''),
            'type': source.get('type', 'unknown'),
            'reliability_score': 0.5,
            'is_known_credible': False,
            'warning': None
        }
        
        url = source.get('url', '')
        if url:
            try:
                domain = urlparse(url).netloc.lower()                # Extract registered domain using tldextract for accurate comparison
                import tldextract
                extracted = tldextract.extract(domain)
                registered_domain = f"{extracted.domain}.{extracted.suffix}"
                
                if registered_domain in self.credible_sources:                    result['reliability_score'] = 0.9
                    result['is_known_credible'] = True
                elif domain.endswith('.gov') or domain.endswith('.edu'):
                    result['reliability_score'] = 0.8
                elif 'twitter.com' in domain or 'facebook.com' in domain:
                    result['reliability_score'] = 0.3
                    result['warning'] = 'Social media source - requires additional verification'
            except:
                pass
        
        # Check source metadata
        if source.get('official', False):
            result['reliability_score'] = max(result['reliability_score'], 0.7)
        
        if source.get('anonymous', False):
            result['reliability_score'] *= 0.5
            result['warning'] = 'Anonymous source - reduced credibility'
        
        return result
    
    def _analyze_content(self, content: str) -> Dict:
        """Analyze article content for credibility indicators"""
        result = {
            'credibility_score': 0.5,
            'has_quotes': False,
            'has_data': False,
            'sentiment_score': 0.0,
            'readability_score': 0.0
        }
        
        # Check for quotes
        quote_pattern = r'["\'][^"\']+["\']'
        if re.search(quote_pattern, content):
            result['has_quotes'] = True
            result['credibility_score'] += 0.1
        
        # Check for data/statistics
        num_pattern = r'\b\d+\.?\d*\b'
        numbers = re.findall(num_pattern, content)
        if len(numbers) >= 3:
            result['has_data'] = True
            result['credibility_score'] += 0.15
        
        # Use ML model for content analysis
        if self.is_trained and len(content) > 50:
            try:
                prob = self.pipeline.predict_proba([content])[0]
                if len(prob) > 1:
                    result['credibility_score'] = prob[1]  # Probability of being credible
            except:
                pass
        
        # Cap score between 0 and 1
        result['credibility_score'] = max(0.0, min(1.0, result['credibility_score']))
        
        return result
    
    def retrain_model(self, texts: List[str], labels: List[int]):
        """Retrain the ML model with new data"""
        self.pipeline.fit(texts, labels)
        self.is_trained = True
        joblib.dump(self.pipeline, 'verification_model.pkl')

class SummaryAIAgent(AIAgent):

class InsightAIAgent(AIAgent):

# ==================== Core System Components ====================

class NewsCollab:
    """
    Main system class for collaborative news analysis and curation.
    Manages AI agents, news fetching, curation, and user interactions.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.agents: Dict[str, AIAgent] = {}
        self.fetchers: List[NewsFetcher] = []
        self.articles: Dict[str, NewsArticle] = {}
        self.analysis_results: Dict[str, List[AnalysisResult]] = defaultdict(list)
        self.curated_items: Dict[str, CuratedNewsItem] = {}
        self.user_profiles: Dict[str, UserProfile] = {}
        self.agent_weights: Dict[str, float] = {}
        
    def register_agent(self, agent: AIAgent):
        """Register an AI agent with the system."""
        self.agents[agent.agent_id] = agent
        self.agent_weights[agent.agent_id] = agent.trust_weight
        logger.info(f"Registered agent: {agent.agent_id}")
    
    def register_fetcher(self, fetcher: NewsFetcher):
        """Register a news fetcher with the system."""
        self.fetchers.append(fetcher)
        logger.info(f"Registered news fetcher: {fetcher.__class__.__name__}")
    
    def register_user(self, user_id: str, preferred_categories: List[str] = None):
        """Register a new user with the system."""
        if user_id not in self.user_profiles:
            self.user_profiles[user_id] = UserProfile(
                user_id=user_id,
                preferred_categories=preferred_categories or []
            )
            logger.info(f"Registered user: {user_id}")
    
    async def fetch_all_articles(self):
        """Fetch articles from all registered sources."""
        tasks = [fetcher.fetch_articles() for fetcher in self.fetchers]
        results = await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)
        
        for result in results:
            if isinstance(result, Exception):
                logger.error(f"Error in fetching articles: {result}")
                continue
                
            for article in result:
                self.articles[article.id] = article
                logger.info(f"Fetched article: {article.title}")
    
    async def analyze_articles(self):
        """Distribute articles to all agents for analysis."""
        if not self.articles:
            logger.warning("No articles to analyze")
            return
        
        analysis_tasks = []
        for article in self.articles.values():
            for agent in self.agents.values():
                # Only analyze if agent has relevant expertise
                if (not agent.expertise or 
                    any(cat in agent.expertise for cat in article.categories)):
                    analysis_tasks.append(agent.analyze_article(article))
        
        results = await asyncio.gather(*analysis_tasks, return_exceptions=True)
        
        for result in results:
            if isinstance(result, Exception):
                logger.error(f"Error in article analysis: {result}")
                continue
                
            self.analysis_results[result.article_id].append(result)
            logger.info(f"Analysis completed by {result.agent_id} for article {result.article_id}")
    
    def curate_news(self) -> List[CuratedNewsItem]:
        """
        Curate news items by combining analyses from multiple agents.
        Implements collaborative filtering and weighting based on agent trust.
        """
        curated_items = []
        
        for article_id, analyses in self.analysis_results.items():
            if not analyses:
                continue
                
            article = self.articles.get(article_id)
            if not article:
                continue
            
            # Calculate weighted scores based on agent trust
            weighted_scores = []
            combined_insights = []
            agent_contributions = []
            
            for analysis in analyses:
                weight = self.agent_weights.get(analysis.agent_id, 1.0)
                weighted_score = analysis.relevance_score * weight
                weighted_scores.append(weighted_score)
                combined_insights.extend(analysis.insights[:2])  # Take top 2 insights
                agent_contributions.append(analysis.agent_id)
            
            # Calculate final relevance score
            if weighted_scores:
                avg_score = sum(weighted_scores) / len(weighted_scores)
            else:
                avg_score = 0.5
            
            # Combine summaries
            combined_summary = " | ".join([a.summary for a in analyses[:3]])
            
            curated_item = CuratedNewsItem(
                id=f"curated_{article_id}",
                article=article,
                combined_summary=combined_summary,
                combined_insights=list(set(combined_insights))[:5],  # Deduplicate and limit
                relevance_score=avg_score,
                agents_contributions=list(set(agent_contributions))
            )
            
            self.curated_items[curated_item.id] = curated_item
            curated_items.append(curated_item)
        
        # Sort by relevance score
        curated_items.sort(key=lambda x: x.relevance_score, reverse=True)
        logger.info(f"Curated {len(curated_items)} news items")
        return curated_items
    
    def get_personalized_recommendations(self, user_id: str, limit: int = 10) -> List[CuratedNewsItem]:
        """
        Get personalized news recommendations for a user.
        Considers user preferences, feedback history, and interaction patterns.
        """
        if user_id not in self.user_profiles:
            self.register_user(user_id)
        
        user_profile = self.user_profiles[user_id]
        all_items = list(self.curated_items.values())
        
        if not all_items:
            return []
        
        # Score items based on personalization factors
        scored_items = []
        for item in all_items:
            if item.id in user_profile.viewed_items:
                continue
            
            score = item.relevance_score
            
            # Boost score for preferred categories
            if user_profile.preferred_categories:
                category_match = any(
                    cat in user_profile.preferred_categories 
                    for cat in item.article.categories
                )
                if category_match:
                    score *= 1.5
            
            # Adjust based on feedback history (simplified)
            for feedback in user_profile.feedback_history:
                if feedback.item_id == item.id:
                    score *= (0.5 + feedback.relevance_rating)
            
            scored_items.append((score, item))
        
        # Sort by personalized score
        scored_items.sort(key=lambda x: x[0], reverse=True)
        recommendations = [item for _, item in scored_items[:limit]]
        
        logger.info(f"Generated {len(recommendations)} recommendations for user {user_id}")
        return recommendations
    
    def record_feedback(self, user_id: str, item_id: str, relevance_rating: float, quality_rating: float):
        """
        Record user feedback and update system weights accordingly.
        """

class AdaptiveSuggester:
    """Provides adaptive suggestions based on user behavior and context"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.user_history: Dict[str, List[Dict]] = defaultdict(list)
        self.color_palettes = {
            "sketching": ["#000000", "#808080", "#A9A9A9"],
            "colorful": ["#FF6B6B", "#4ECDC4", "#FFD166", "#06D6A0"],
            "professional": ["#2C3E50", "#34495E", "#7F8C8D"]
        }
    
    def record_tool_usage(self, user_id: str, tool: ToolType, color: str, size: int) -> None:
        """Record user's tool usage for pattern analysis"""
        self.user_history[user_id].append({
            "tool": tool.value,
            "color": color,
            "size": size,
            "timestamp": datetime.datetime.now()
        })
        # Keep only last 100 entries per user
        if len(self.user_history[user_id]) > 100:
            self.user_history[user_id] = self.user_history[user_id][-100:]
    
    def suggest_tool(self, user_id: str, context: str = "") -> Tuple[ToolType, str, int]:
        """Suggest tool based on user history and context"""
        if user_id not in self.user_history or not self.user_history[user_id]:
            # Default suggestions for new users
            return ToolType.BRUSH, "#000000", 3
        
        recent_uses = self.user_history[user_id][-10:]
        
        # Find most used tool
        tool_counts = defaultdict(int)
        for use in recent_uses:
            tool_counts[use["tool"]] += 1
        
        most_used_tool = max(tool_counts.items(), key=lambda x: x[1])[0]
        
        # Suggest based on context
        if context == "sketching":
            return ToolType.PEN, "#000000", 2
        elif context == "highlighting":
            return ToolType.HIGHLIGHTER, "#FFD700", 5
        
        # Suggest based on history
        last_use = recent_uses[-1]
        return ToolType(last_use["tool"]), last_use["color"], last_use["size"]
    
    def suggest_color_palette(self, context: str) -> List[str]:
        """Suggest color palette based on drawing context"""
        return self.color_palettes.get(context, self.color_palettes["colorful"])

class DrawingFeedback:
    """Provides real-time feedback on drawing accuracy and style"""
    
    @staticmethod
    def check_smoothness(points: List[Tuple[float, float]]) -> float:
        """Calculate smoothness of a stroke (0-1 scale)"""
        if len(points) < 3:
            return 1.0
        
        total_distance = 0
        for i in range(1, len(points)):
            x1, y1 = points[i-1]
            x2, y2 = points[i]
            total_distance += ((x2 - x1) ** 2 + (y2 - y1) ** 2) ** 0.5
        
        if total_distance == 0:
            return 1.0
        
        # Simple smoothness metric (higher is smoother)
        return min(1.0, 100 / total_distance)
    
    @staticmethod
    def suggest_improvement(smoothness: float) -> str:
        """Provide feedback based on smoothness score"""
        if smoothness > 0.8:
            return "Great line quality!"
        elif smoothness > 0.5:
            return "Good stroke. Try drawing slower for even smoother lines."
        else:
            return "Consider using stabilization or drawing with more deliberate strokes."

class CollaborationEngine:
    """Handles real-time collaboration between users"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.active_users: Dict[str, User] = {}
        self.page_subscribers: Dict[str, List[str]] = defaultdict(list)  # page_id -> [user_ids]
        self.undo_stack: Dict[str, List[DrawingStroke]] = defaultdict(list)
        self.redo_stack: Dict[str, List[DrawingStroke]] = defaultdict(list)
    
    def add_user(self, user: User) -> None:
        """Add user to collaboration session"""
        self.active_users[user.id] = user
    
    def remove_user(self, user_id: str) -> None:
        """Remove user from collaboration session"""
        if user_id in self.active_users:
            del self.active_users[user_id]
        
        # Remove from all page subscriptions
        for page_id in self.page_subscribers:
            if user_id in self.page_subscribers[page_id]:
                self.page_subscribers[page_id].remove(user_id)
    
    def subscribe_to_page(self, user_id: str, page_id: str) -> None:
        """Subscribe user to page updates"""
        if user_id not in self.page_subscribers[page_id]:
            self.page_subscribers[page_id].append(user_id)
    
    def unsubscribe_from_page(self, user_id: str, page_id: str) -> None:
        """Unsubscribe user from page updates"""
        if user_id in self.page_subscribers[page_id]:
            self.page_subscribers[page_id].remove(user_id)
    
    def broadcast_stroke(self, page_id: str, stroke: DrawingStroke) -> List[str]:
        """Broadcast new stroke to all subscribers"""
        subscribers = self.page_subscribers.get(page_id, [])
        # Add to undo stack for the page
        self.undo_stack[page_id].append(stroke)
        # Clear redo stack when new stroke is added
        self.redo_stack[page_id].clear()
        return subscribers
    
    def undo_last_stroke(self, page_id: str) -> Optional[DrawingStroke]:
        """Undo the last stroke on a page"""
        if self.undo_stack[page_id]:
            last_stroke = self.undo_stack[page_id].pop()
            self.redo_stack[page_id].append(last_stroke)
            return last_stroke
        return None
    
    def redo_last_stroke(self, page_id: str) -> Optional[DrawingStroke]:
        """Redo the last undone stroke on a page"""
        if self.redo_stack[page_id]:
            last_undone = self.redo_stack[page_id].pop()
            self.undo_stack[page_id].append(last_undone)
            return last_undone
        return None

    r: int
    g: int
    b: int
    a: int = 255  # Alpha channel

        """Convert to hex color code"""
        return f"#{self.r:02x}{self.g:02x}{self.b:02x}{self.a:02x}"
    
    @classmethod
    def from_hex(cls, hex_code: str) -> 'Color':
        """Create from hex color code"""
        hex_code = hex_code.lstrip('#')
        if len(hex_code) == 6:

                int(hex_code[2:4], 16),
                int(hex_code[4:6], 16)
            )
        elif len(hex_code) == 8:

# ======================== Data Models ========================

class ToolType(Enum):
    """Enumeration of available drawing tools"""
    BRUSH = "brush"
    PEN = "pen"
    MARKER = "marker"
    ERASER = "eraser"
    HIGHLIGHTER = "highlighter"
    SHAPE = "shape"

class UserRole(Enum):
    """Enumeration of user roles with different permission levels"""
    VIEWER = "viewer"      # Can only view
    EDITOR = "editor"      # Can draw and annotate
    ADMIN = "admin"        # Can manage pages and users

@dataclass
class DrawingStroke:
    """Represents a single drawing stroke"""
    id: str
    tool: ToolType
    color: str
    size: int
    points: List[Tuple[float, float]]
    user_id: str
    timestamp: datetime.datetime

@dataclass
class Annotation:
    """Represents a comment or annotation on a drawing"""
    id: str

    timestamp: datetime.datetime
    tags: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)

@dataclass
class PageVersion:
    """Represents a version of a page for history tracking"""
    version_id: str
    timestamp: datetime.datetime
    strokes: List[DrawingStroke]
    annotations: List[Annotation]
    user_id: str
    description: str = ""

@dataclass
class NotebookPage:
    """Represents a single page in the notebook"""
    id: str
    title: str
    created_at: datetime.datetime
    created_by: str
    strokes: List[DrawingStroke] = field(default_factory=list)
    annotations: List[Annotation] = field(default_factory=list)
    versions: List[PageVersion] = field(default_factory=list)
    
    def add_stroke(self, stroke: DrawingStroke) -> None:
        """Add a new stroke to the page"""
        self.strokes.append(stroke)
    
    def add_annotation(self, annotation: Annotation) -> None:
        """Add a new annotation to the page"""
        self.annotations.append(annotation)
    
    def create_version(self, user_id: str, description: str = "") -> str:
        """Create a new version snapshot of the page"""
        version_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
        version = PageVersion(
            version_id=version_id,
            timestamp=datetime.datetime.now(),
            strokes=self.strokes.copy(),
            annotations=self.annotations.copy(),
            user_id=user_id,
            description=description
        )
        self.versions.append(version)
        return version_id
    
    def revert_to_version(self, version_id: str) -> bool:
        """Revert page to a specific version"""
        for version in self.versions:
            if version.version_id == version_id:
                self.strokes = version.strokes.copy()
                self.annotations = version.annotations.copy()
                return True
        return False

# ======================== Adaptive Features ========================

class AdaptiveSuggester:
    """Provides adaptive suggestions based on user behavior and context"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.user_history: Dict[str, List[Dict]] = defaultdict(list)
        self.color_palettes = {
            "sketching": ["#000000", "#808080", "#A9A9A9"],
            "colorful": ["#FF6B6B", "#4ECDC4", "#FFD166", "#06D6A0"],
            "professional": ["#2C3E50", "#34495E", "#7F8C8D"]
        }
    
    def record_tool_usage(self, user_id: str, tool: ToolType, color: str, size: int) -> None:
        """Record user's tool usage for pattern analysis"""
        self.user_history[user_id].append({
            "tool": tool.value,
            "color": color,
            "size": size,
            "timestamp": datetime.datetime.now()
        })
        # Keep only last 100 entries per user
        if len(self.user_history[user_id]) > 100:
            self.user_history[user_id] = self.user_history[user_id][-100:]
    
    def suggest_tool(self, user_id: str, context: str = "") -> Tuple[ToolType, str, int]:
        """Suggest tool based on user history and context"""
        if user_id not in self.user_history or not self.user_history[user_id]:
            # Default suggestions for new users
            return ToolType.BRUSH, "#000000", 3
        
        recent_uses = self.user_history[user_id][-10:]
        
        # Find most used tool
        tool_counts = defaultdict(int)
        for use in recent_uses:
            tool_counts[use["tool"]] += 1
        
        most_used_tool = max(tool_counts.items(), key=lambda x: x[1])[0]
        
        # Suggest based on context
        if context == "sketching":
            return ToolType.PEN, "#000000", 2
        elif context == "highlighting":
            return ToolType.HIGHLIGHTER, "#FFD700", 5
        
        # Suggest based on history
        last_use = recent_uses[-1]
        return ToolType(last_use["tool"]), last_use["color"], last_use["size"]
    
    def suggest_color_palette(self, context: str) -> List[str]:
        """Suggest color palette based on drawing context"""
        return self.color_palettes.get(context, self.color_palettes["colorful"])

class DrawingFeedback:
    """Provides real-time feedback on drawing accuracy and style"""
    
    @staticmethod
    def check_smoothness(points: List[Tuple[float, float]]) -> float:
        """Calculate smoothness of a stroke (0-1 scale)"""
        if len(points) < 3:
            return 1.0
        
        total_distance = 0
        for i in range(1, len(points)):
            x1, y1 = points[i-1]
            x2, y2 = points[i]
            total_distance += ((x2 - x1) ** 2 + (y2 - y1) ** 2) ** 0.5
        
        if total_distance == 0:
            return 1.0
        
        # Simple smoothness metric (higher is smoother)
        return min(1.0, 100 / total_distance)
    
    @staticmethod
    def suggest_improvement(smoothness: float) -> str:
        """Provide feedback based on smoothness score"""
        if smoothness > 0.8:
            return "Great line quality!"
        elif smoothness > 0.5:
            return "Good stroke. Try drawing slower for even smoother lines."
        else:
            return "Consider using stabilization or drawing with more deliberate strokes."

# ======================== Collaboration Engine ========================

class CollaborationEngine:
    """Handles real-time collaboration between users"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.active_users: Dict[str, User] = {}
        self.page_subscribers: Dict[str, List[str]] = defaultdict(list)  # page_id -> [user_ids]
        self.undo_stack: Dict[str, List[DrawingStroke]] = defaultdict(list)
        self.redo_stack: Dict[str, List[DrawingStroke]] = defaultdict(list)
    
    def add_user(self, user: User) -> None:
        """Add user to collaboration session"""
        self.active_users[user.id] = user
    
    def remove_user(self, user_id: str) -> None:
        """Remove user from collaboration session"""
        if user_id in self.active_users:
            del self.active_users[user_id]
        
        # Remove from all page subscriptions
        for page_id in self.page_subscribers:
            if user_id in self.page_subscribers[page_id]:
                self.page_subscribers[page_id].remove(user_id)
    
    def subscribe_to_page(self, user_id: str, page_id: str) -> None:
        """Subscribe user to page updates"""
        if user_id not in self.page_subscribers[page_id]:
            self.page_subscribers[page_id].append(user_id)
    
    def unsubscribe_from_page(self, user_id: str, page_id: str) -> None:
        """Unsubscribe user from page updates"""
        if user_id in self.page_subscribers[page_id]:
            self.page_subscribers[page_id].remove(user_id)
    
    def broadcast_stroke(self, page_id: str, stroke: DrawingStroke) -> List[str]:
        """Broadcast new stroke to all subscribers"""
        subscribers = self.page_subscribers.get(page_id, [])
        # Add to undo stack for the page
        self.undo_stack[page_id].append(stroke)
        # Clear redo stack when new stroke is added
        self.redo_stack[page_id].clear()
        return subscribers
    
    def undo_last_stroke(self, page_id: str) -> Optional[DrawingStroke]:
        """Undo the last stroke on a page"""
        if self.undo_stack[page_id]:
            last_stroke = self.undo_stack[page_id].pop()
            self.redo_stack[page_id].append(last_stroke)
            return last_stroke
        return None
    
    def redo_last_stroke(self, page_id: str) -> Optional[DrawingStroke]:
        """Redo the last undone stroke on a page"""
        if self.redo_stack[page_id]:
            last_undone = self.redo_stack[page_id].pop()
            self.undo_stack[page_id].append(last_undone)
            return last_undone
        return None

# ======================== Notebook Manager ========================

class NotebookManager:
    """Manages the notebook, pages, and user permissions"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.pages: Dict[str, NotebookPage] = {}
        self.users: Dict[str, User] = {}
        self.collaboration_engine = CollaborationEngine()
        self.adaptive_suggester = AdaptiveSuggester()
        self.auto_save_interval = 300  # 5 minutes in seconds
    
    def create_user(self, username: str, role: UserRole = UserRole.EDITOR) -> str:
        """Create a new user and return user ID"""
        user_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
        user = User(
            id=user_id,
            username=username,
            role=role
        )
        self.users[user_id] = user
        self.collaboration_engine.add_user(user)
        return user_id
    
    def create_page(self, user_id: str, title: str = "Untitled Page") -> Optional[str]:
        """Create a new page in the notebook"""
        if user_id not in self.users:
            return None
        
        user = self.users[user_id]
        if user.role == UserRole.VIEWER:
            return None  # Viewers cannot create pages
        
        page_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
        page = NotebookPage(
            id=page_id,
            title=title,
            created_at=datetime.datetime.now(),
            created_by=user_id
        )
        self.pages[page_id] = page
        return page_id
    
    def add_stroke_to_page(self, page_id: str, user_id: str, tool: ToolType, 
                          color: str, size: int, points: List[Tuple[float, float]]) -> Optional[DrawingStroke]:
        """Add a drawing stroke to a page"""
        if page_id not in self.pages or user_id not in self.users:
            return None
        
        user = self.users[user_id]
        if user.role == UserRole.VIEWER:
            return None  # Viewers cannot draw
        
        stroke = DrawingStroke(
            id=str(uuid.uuid4()),
            tool=tool,
            color=color,
            size=size,
            points=points,
            user_id=user_id,
            timestamp=datetime.datetime.now(),
            page_id=page_id
        )
        
        self.pages[page_id].add_stroke(stroke)
        
        # Record for adaptive suggestions
        self.adaptive_suggester.record_tool_usage(user_id, tool, color, size)
        
        # Broadcast to collaborators
        self.collaboration_engine.broadcast_stroke(page_id, stroke)
        
        return stroke
    
    def add_annotation_to_page(self, page_id: str, user_id: str, text: str, 
                              position: Tuple[float, float], tags: List[str] = None, 
                              element_id: Optional[str] = None) -> Optional[Annotation]:
        """Add an annotation to a page"""
        if page_id not in self.pages or user_id not in self.users:
            return None
        
        user = self.users[user_id]
        if user.role == UserRole.VIEWER:
            return None  # Viewers cannot annotate
        
        annotation = Annotation(
            id=str(uuid.uuid4()),
            user_id=user_id,
            text=text,
            position=position,
            tags=tags or [],
            timestamp=datetime.datetime.now(),
            element_id=element_id
        )
        
        self.pages[page_id].add_annotation(annotation)
        return annotation
    
    def get_page_versions(self, page_id: str) -> List[PageVersion]:
        """Get all versions of a page"""
        if page_id in self.pages:
            return self.pages[page_id].versions
        return []
    
    def revert_page_to_version(self, page_id: str, version_id: str, user_id: str) -> bool:
        """Revert a page to a specific version"""
        if page_id not in self.pages or user_id not in self.users:
            return False
        
        user = self.users[user_id]
        if user.role != UserRole.ADMIN and user_id != self.pages[page_id].created_by:
            return False  # Only admins or page creators can revert
        
        return self.pages[page_id].revert_to_version(version_id)
    
    def auto_save_all_pages(self) -> None:
        """Auto-save all pages by creating versions"""
        for page_id, page in self.pages.items():
            if page.strokes:  # Only save if there are changes
                page.create_version("system", "Auto-save")
    
    def get_user_suggestions(self, user_id: str, context: str = "") -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Get adaptive suggestions for a user"""
        tool, color, size = self.adaptive_suggester.suggest_tool(user_id, context)
        palette = self.adaptive_suggester.suggest_color_palette(context)
        
        return {
            "tool": tool.value,
            "color": color,
            "size": size,
            "color_palette": palette
        }

# ======================== User Interface Components ========================

class UIManager:
    """Manages the user interface components (simplified for backend)"""
    
    @staticmethod
    def create_toolbar(tools: List[ToolType], current_tool: ToolType, 
                      colors: List[str], current_color: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Create toolbar configuration"""
        return {
            "tools": [tool.value for tool in tools],
            "current_tool": current_tool.value,
            "colors": colors,
            "current_color": current_color,
            "size_range": [1, 10],
            "current_size": 3
        }
    
    @staticmethod
    def create_page_selector(pages: List[NotebookPage], current_page_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Create page selector configuration"""
        page_info = []
        for page in pages:
            page_info.append({
                "id": page.id,
                "title": page.title,
                "created_by": page.created_by,
                "created_at": page.created_at.isoformat(),
                "stroke_count": len(page.strokes),
                "annotation_count": len(page.annotations)
            })
        
        return {
            "pages": page_info,
            "current_page": current_page_id,
            "can_create_new": True
        }
    
    @staticmethod
    def create_collaboration_panel(users: List[User]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Create collaboration panel showing active users"""
        user_info = []
        for user in users:
            user_info.append({
                "id": user.id,
                "username": user.username,
                "role": user.role.value,
                "last_active": user.last_active.isoformat()
            })
        
        return {
            "active_users": user_info,
            "total_users": len(users)
        }

            return True
        
        return False

        """Logout current user."""
        self.current_user = None

        if self.storage.get_user(username):

        """Get tasks with deadlines within the specified number of days."""
        now = datetime.now()
        end_date = now + timedelta(days=days_ahead)
        
        tasks = []
        for task in self.task_manager.tasks.values():
            if (task.assigned_to == self.user_id and 
                task.status != TaskStatus.COMPLETED and
                now <= task.deadline <= end_date):
                tasks.append(task)
        
        # Sort by deadline
        tasks.sort(key=lambda t: t.deadline)
        return tasks
    
    def get_completed_tasks(self) -> List[Task]:
        """Get completed tasks for the user."""
        tasks = []
        for task in self.task_manager.tasks.values():
            if (task.assigned_to == self.user_id and 
                task.status == TaskStatus.COMPLETED):
                tasks.append(task)
        
        # Sort by completion date (updated_at)
        tasks.sort(key=lambda t: t.updated_at, reverse=True)
        return tasks

        assigned_tasks = self.get_assigned_tasks()

        upcoming_tasks = self.get_upcoming_deadlines(30)
        overdue_tasks = [t for t in assigned_tasks if t.is_overdue()]

    """Generates various reports about tasks and team performance."""

        """Initialize report generator with task manager."""
        self.task_manager = task_manager
    
    def generate_task_completion_report(self, project_id: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict:
        """Generate report on task completion rates."""
        tasks = self.task_manager.tasks.values()
        
        if project_id:
            tasks = [t for t in tasks if t.project_id == project_id]
        
        total_tasks = len(tasks)
        if total_tasks == 0:
            return {"error": "No tasks found"}
        
        completed_tasks = len([t for t in tasks 
                              if t.status == TaskStatus.COMPLETED])
        in_progress_tasks = len([t for t in tasks 
                                if t.status == TaskStatus.IN_PROGRESS])
        not_started_tasks = len([t for t in tasks 
                                if t.status == TaskStatus.NOT_STARTED])
        
        completion_rate = (completed_tasks / total_tasks * 100) if total_tasks > 0 else 0
        
        return {
            "total_tasks": total_tasks,
            "completed_tasks": completed_tasks,
            "in_progress_tasks": in_progress_tasks,
            "not_started_tasks": not_started_tasks,
            "completion_rate": round(completion_rate, 2),
            "overdue_tasks": len([t for t in tasks if t.is_overdue()])
        }
    
    def generate_team_performance_report(self) -> Dict[str, Dict]:
        """Generate performance report for each team member."""
        report = {}
        
        for user_id, user in self.task_manager.users.items():
            user_tasks = self.task_manager.get_user_tasks(user_id)
            assigned_tasks = user_tasks["assigned"]
            
            if not assigned_tasks:
                continue
            
            completed_tasks = len([t for t in assigned_tasks 
                                  if t.status == TaskStatus.COMPLETED])
            overdue_tasks = len([t for t in assigned_tasks if t.is_overdue()])
            
            completion_rate = (completed_tasks / len(assigned_tasks) * 100) if assigned_tasks else 0
            
            report[user_id] = {
                "user_name": user.name,
                "total_assigned": len(assigned_tasks),
                "completed": completed_tasks,
                "completion_rate": round(completion_rate, 2),
                "overdue_tasks": overdue_tasks,
                "avg_time_to_complete": self._calculate_avg_completion_time(assigned_tasks)
            }
        
        return report
    
    def generate_project_progress_report(self) -> Dict[str, Dict]:
        """Generate progress report for each project."""
        report = {}
        
        for project_id, project_name in self.task_manager.projects.items():
            project_tasks = self.task_manager.get_tasks_by_project(project_id)
            
            if not project_tasks:
                continue
            
            completed_tasks = len([t for t in project_tasks 
                                  if t.status == TaskStatus.COMPLETED])
            completion_rate = (completed_tasks / len(project_tasks) * 100) if project_tasks else 0
            
            report[project_id] = {
                "project_name": project_name,
                "total_tasks": len(project_tasks),
                "completed_tasks": completed_tasks,
                "completion_rate": round(completion_rate, 2),
                "overdue_tasks": len([t for t in project_tasks if t.is_overdue()])
            }
        
        return report
    
    def _calculate_avg_completion_time(self, tasks: List[Task]) -> Optional[float]:
        """Calculate average completion time in days for completed tasks."""
        completed_tasks = [t for t in tasks if t.status == TaskStatus.COMPLETED]
        
        if not completed_tasks:
            return None
        
        total_days = 0
        for task in completed_tasks:
            completion_time = task.updated_at - task.created_at
            total_days += completion_time.days
        
        return round(total_days / len(completed_tasks), 2)

    IN_PROGRESS = "in_progress"
    COMPLETED = "completed"
    BLOCKED = "blocked"

class PriorityLevel(Enum):
    """Enumeration of task priority levels."""
    LOW = "low"
    MEDIUM = "medium"
    HIGH = "high"
    CRITICAL = "critical"

    URGENT = "urgent"

@dataclass

    """Represents a system user/team member."""
    id: str

    email: str

    id: str

    content: str

            "sender_id": self.sender_id,
            "content": self.content,
            "timestamp": self.timestamp.isoformat()

    id: str

    created_at: datetime = field(default_factory=datetime.now)

    messages: List[Message] = field(default_factory=list)
    
    def update_status(self, new_status: TaskStatus) -> None:

        self.status = new_status
        self.updated_at = datetime.now()
    messages: List[Message] = field(default_factory=list)

        """Add a message to the task."""
        self.messages.append(message)
    
    def is_overdue(self) -> bool:
        """Check if task is overdue."""
        return datetime.now() > self.deadline and self.status != TaskStatus.COMPLETED
    
    def to_dict(self) -> Dict:
        """Convert task to dictionary for serialization."""
        return {

class UserRole(Enum):

class Observer(ABC):
    """Abstract base class for observers in the observer pattern."""
    
    @abstractmethod
    def update(self, subject, event_type: str, data: Dict):
        """Receive update from subject."""

class TaskSubject:
    """Subject that notifies observers of task changes."""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self._observers: List[Observer] = []
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
    
    def attach(self, observer: Observer) -> None:
        """Attach an observer to the subject."""
        with self._lock:
            if observer not in self._observers:
                self._observers.append(observer)
    
    def detach(self, observer: Observer) -> None:
        """Detach an observer from the subject."""
        with self._lock:
            if observer in self._observers:

    def notify(self, event_type: str, data: Dict) -> None:

class Observer(ABC):
    """Abstract base class for observers in the observer pattern."""
    
    @abstractmethod
    def update(self, subject, event_type: str, data: Dict):
        """Receive update from subject."""
        pass

class TaskSubject:
    """Subject that notifies observers of task changes."""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self._observers: List[Observer] = []
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
    
    def attach(self, observer: Observer) -> None:
        """Attach an observer to the subject."""
        with self._lock:
            if observer not in self._observers:
                self._observers.append(observer)
    
    def detach(self, observer: Observer) -> None:
        """Detach an observer from the subject."""
        with self._lock:
            if observer in self._observers:
                self._observers.remove(observer)
    
    def notify(self, event_type: str, data: Dict) -> None:
        """Notify all observers about an event."""
        with self._lock:
            for observer in self._observers:
                observer.update(self, event_type, data)

PhotoCollab is a web-based application that provides a suite of tools for photo editing, including basic adjustments, filters, and advanced features like object removal and background replacement. # ==================== MODELS ====================

class User(db.Model):
    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    username = db.Column(db.String(80), unique=True, nullable=False)
    email = db.Column(db.String(120), unique=True, nullable=False)
    password_hash = db.Column(db.String(200), nullable=False)
    created_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)
    
    projects = db.relationship('Project', secondary='project_members', back_populates='members')

class Project(db.Model):
    id = db.Column(db.String(36), primary_key=True, default=lambda: str(uuid.uuid4()))
    name = db.Column(db.String(200), nullable=False)
    description = db.Column(db.Text)
    owner_id = db.Column(db.Integer, db.ForeignKey('user.id'), nullable=False)
    created_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)
    updated_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, onupdate=datetime.utcnow)
    
    owner = db.relationship('User', backref='owned_projects')
    members = db.relationship('User', secondary='project_members', back_populates='projects')
    images = db.relationship('ProjectImage', backref='project', cascade='all, delete-orphan')
    versions = db.relationship('ProjectVersion', backref='project', cascade='all, delete-orphan')

class ProjectMember(db.Model):
    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    project_id = db.Column(db.String(36), db.ForeignKey('project.id'), nullable=False)
    user_id = db.Column(db.Integer, db.ForeignKey('user.id'), nullable=False)
    joined_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)
    role = db.Column(db.String(20), default='editor')  # editor, viewer

class ProjectImage(db.Model):
    id = db.Column(db.String(36), primary_key=True, default=lambda: str(uuid.uuid4()))
    project_id = db.Column(db.String(36), db.ForeignKey('project.id'), nullable=False)
    filename = db.Column(db.String(255), nullable=False)
    original_filename = db.Column(db.String(255), nullable=False)
    upload_date = db.Column(db.DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)
    current_version = db.Column(db.Integer, default=1)
    
    versions = db.relationship('ImageVersion', backref='image', cascade='all, delete-orphan')

class ImageVersion(db.Model):
    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)

def index():
    if 'user_id' in session:
        return redirect(url_for('dashboard'))
    return render_template('index.html')

@app.route('/register', methods=['POST'])
def register():
    data = request.json
    username = data.get('username')
    email = data.get('email')
    password = data.get('password')
    
    if User.query.filter_by(username=username).first():
        return jsonify({'error': 'Username already exists'}), 400
    if User.query.filter_by(email=email).first():
        return jsonify({'error': 'Email already registered'}), 400
    
    hashed_password = generate_password_hash(password)
    user = User(username=username, email=email, password_hash=hashed_password)
    db.session.add(user)
    db.session.commit()
    
    return jsonify({'message': 'User created successfully', 'user_id': user.id})

@app.route('/login', methods=['POST'])
def login():
    data = request.json
    username = data.get('username')
    password = data.get('password')
    
    user = User.query.filter_by(username=username).first()
    if user and check_password_hash(user.password_hash, password):
        session['user_id'] = user.id
        session['username'] = user.username
        return jsonify({'message': 'Login successful', 'user_id': user.id})
    
    return jsonify({'error': 'Invalid credentials'}), 401

@app.route('/logout')
def logout():
    session.clear()
    return jsonify({'message': 'Logged out successfully'})

    if 'user_id' not in session:

    data = request.json
    project = Project(
        name=data['name'],
        description=data.get('description', ''),
        owner_id=session['user_id']

        'project_id': project.id,
        'share_link': f'/project/{project.id}'

    project = Project.query.get_or_404(project_id)
    if project.owner_id != session['user_id']:
        return jsonify({'error': 'Only project owner can invite'}), 403
    
    data = request.json
    email = data.get('email')
    
    user = User.query.filter_by(email=email).first()
    if not user:
        return jsonify({'error': 'User not found'}), 404

    return jsonify({'message': 'User invited successfully'})
